bio: Postdoctoral Research Fellow Environmental Health, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Environmental Health Joyce is a postdoctoral fellow in the Weisskopf Lab, where she leads multiple projects in the St. Louis Baby Tooth - Later Life Health Study. She brings expertise in biomonitoring within large-scale epidemiological studies and has particular interest in non-invasive biomarkers of metal exposure. Her research focuses on early life origins of disease and understanding the health impacts of chemical exposures over the life course. PhD, Environmental Health Johns Hopkins School of Public Health
